title: Licensed Customer Service Representative
description: Description Join Our Team as a Remote Experienced and Licensed Customer Service Representative! Within our Customer Response Center, the Remote Customer Service Representative provides timely, accurate and responsive information and service to policyholders and agents for a division of Personal Lines products, plans and programs. Independently solve problems relating to policies within scope and escalate others as appropriate. Identifies, analyzes, and owns customer policy needs to ensure high customer satisfaction, growth and retention of business. Training: Paid training is Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm EST (full time). Training is a critical component to your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory for success in this role. Shift: After onboarding and training is complete, go-forward shifts will have a start time between Shift hours 8:30 am -10:30 am EST with a weekend rotation. One weekend day (Saturday or Sunday) will be required with an alternate day off mid-week when working the weekend. Work Location: All equipment is provided. However, to work from home you must have dependable, wired internet connectivity with an upload speed of at least 5Mbps and a download speed of at least 25Mbps along with a quiet, secure, distraction free place to work. License: Active P&C Producers insurance license REQUIRED. We are currently not hiring in NY, CA, AK, HI, NM or IL. Qualifications Associates degree or 1+ year Insurance experience preferred. 2 years'+ related Customer Service experience is required. Ability to review, record and organize written data from a variety of sources with no prescribed format is essential. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required. P&C Producers insurance license required. About Us Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. Apply

Description

The Retreat at Canton is seeking a FT Housekeeper to join their team!

Shift Details

Housekeeper

Tuesday-Saturday

The Housekeeper is responsible for performing all housekeeping activities such as, but not limited to, dusting, vacuuming, sweeping, mopping, laundry, shampooing carpets, scrubbing bathrooms, cleaning counters, taking out the trash and cleaning windows. Responsibilities also include restocking common area bistroâs and bathrooms, resident rooms and bathrooms with the appropriate paper products and hand soap.

Principle Duties And Responsibilities

Housekeeping

  • Follow detailed cleaning worksheet/ checklist for each room and common area
  • Responsible for the set-up and mixing of water and detergents, in proper containers to prepare cleaning solutions, according to specifications
  • Follow procedures for the use of chemical cleaners and power equipment, in order to prevent damage to floors and fixtures
  • Clean community common area and resident room(s) floors and walls by sweeping, mopping, scrubbing, and / or vacuuming
  • Steam clean or shampoo carpet
  • Dust furniture, walls, machines and equipment which include moving furniture around
  • Clean windows, glass partitions, and mirrors, using soapy water or other cleaner, sponges and squeegees
  • Make adjustments to heating cooling and ventilation system which may include changing filters
  • Gather and empty trash
  • Remove debris from outdoor porches, parking lot and dumpster area
  • Ensure all bathrooms (common area, resident) are stocked with toilet paper, paper towels, Kleenex and liquid and soap
  • Replace light bulbs throughout the community
  • Ensure all suites that have 2 residents residing are cleaned twice a week
  • Notify supervisor, by documenting in the maintenance log and housekeeping checklist, concerning the need for major repairs or additions to the building operating systems

#86pgm

Requirements

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/LICENSURE- CERTIFICATION

Housekeeper

  • Education: High School Diploma/ GED required
  • One (1) year job related experience

Skills And Abilities

  • Understanding of infection control procedures
  • Demonstrate the ability to Multi task and Manage Stress
  • Understands and embraces the assisted living philosophy
  • Ability to work weekends, evenings and flexible hours, available for our customers at peak service delivery days and times
  • Possess written and verbal skills for effective communication

Building a sustainable tomorrow

KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator.


The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service. You will also maintain the contents of the permits on site, making sure the workforce remains compliant with conditions and processes outlined within the permits.

Due to the site being a high-security military naval base, additional security checks will be required a BPSS level of security clearance is necessary. These checks can take up to 8 weeks to process. Only candidates holding EU, NATO, 5 Eyes, or MISWG member passports and who have been UK residents for the last 5 years can be considered for this role.

Your team
  • Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth
  • Contract: Permanent, 42.5 hours a week
Making Possible

In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Authorise Permit to Break Surface
  • Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure
  • Review method statements tailored to specific tasks
  • Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards
  • Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services.
  • Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings
  • Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services
  • Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer
  • Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records
  • Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC
  • Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly
  • Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig
  • Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit.
  • Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress
  • This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given
What do you bring to the role?

Essential:

  • We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team
  • A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work)
  • Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential
  • A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important
  • Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required
  • Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6

Desirable

  • Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial
  • QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred
  • Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience
Whats in it for you?
  • Competitive salary
  • A wide range of family-friendly policies
  • Company car/car allowance/travel allowance
  • 8 % matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 days holiday
  • 2 wellbeing days
  • 1 volunteering day
  • Personal and professional development
About BAM

Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.

We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. Were on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics.

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

title: Graduate Quality Officer
description: Be part of a world-class team supporting vital Antarctic research and operations. The AIR Alliance brings together skilled professionals from Bouygues Construction Australia, The Australian Antarctic Division, Stantec and Mott MacDonald to deliver essential services in one of the most challenging and awe-inspiring environments on Earth. If youâre ready to push boundaries, work with cutting-edge projects, and make a real impact, this is your opportunity. About The Role The Quality Graduate supports the Alliance's quality management initiatives through quality assurance activities, compliance monitoring, audits, investigations, reporting, and continuous improvement projects. Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, the role contributes to maintaining compliance with regulatory, contractual, and organisational requirements while supporting the effective operation of the Quality Management System. The Quality Graduate will assist the Quality Manager and Project Controls Manager with data analysis, auditing, risk management, and process improvement, while contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous improvement across the Alliance. Key Responsibilities Compliance with Alliance quality policies and procedures. Timely completion of assigned quality activities and projects. Accuracy and integrity of quality data and reporting. Support the implementation and maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS). Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable standards, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Participate in document control activities, including the review and update of procedures, work instructions, and forms. Maintain quality records, templates, registers, and controlled documents within the Alliance SharePoint quality management environment. Support the development, maintenance, and delivery of the Alliance Internal Audit Schedule. Coordinate audit logistics, track audit findings, and facilitate close-out of corrective actions. Support continuous improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen. Support implementation and verification of quality and compliance requirements associated with the Topside Program, including readiness activities leading to January 2027 delivery milestones. Support review and implementation of Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and verify supplier compliance with agreed inspection and quality requirements. Assist in monitoring supplier quality performance, documentation compliance, and adherence to Alliance quality requirements. Support quality risk identification, assessment, treatment tracking, and reporting in accordance with Alliance risk management processes. Coordinate and maintain records of mandatory quality training and inductions, including Quality Management Plan and Risk Management induction requirements. Qualifications & Experience Completion of a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Science, Business, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering or a related field. Understanding of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 or similar). Awareness of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma. Knowledge of audit principles and risk management concepts. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and Power BI (desirable) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. High level of attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Bouygues Construction Australia values diversity and welcomes applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians. At Bouygues Construction Australia, we are dedicated to the design, construction, and delivery of nation shaping projects across civil infrastructure, engineering, and energy and services.

We have proudly been working in Australia for more than 25 years.

Our local experience in underpinned by significant global expertise and resourcing.

About The Role

As a TBM Technician, you will be responsible for providing civil engineering support and operating the EPB Tunnel Boring Machine on the River Torrens to Darlington (T2D) project on this key civil engineering project.

The T2D project involves the construction of a 10.5-kilometre motorway, with three lanes in each direction and including tunnel sections, linking the River Torrens area in the north to Darlington in the south of Adelaide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyse TBM parameters (face pressure, torque, thrust, spoil removal, etc.) to support civil engineers and ensure adherence to project timelines and compliance to safety standards and technical requirements. Â­
  • Coordinate with civil engineers, segment erectors, and conveyor personnel to maintain continuous operations according to production schedules and timelines, as well as applying appropriate procedures and selecting correct equipment.Â­
  • Continuously observing and analysing live data and adjusting parameters such as face pressure, torque, thrust, and spoil removal to ensure efficient and safe tunnelling. Â­
  • Diagnose and report technical issues to senior civil engineering staff. Â­
  • Ensuring the completed work satisfies the civil infrastructure projectsâ specifications, regulations and contract provisions. Â­
  • Organising and coordinating maintenance and repair work of the TBM equipment. Â­
  • Follow all safety regulations and environmental controls. Â­
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, tabulations and reports to assist with production planning.Â­
  • Participate in daily toolbox talks and safety briefings.
  • Ensure proper handover between shifts

Qualification & Experience

  • Relevant trade qualification or diploma. Â­
  • Significant demonstrated experience in the operation of Tunnel Boring Machines
  • 5+ years in TBM Operation
  • Strong understanding of TBM operational systems including hydraulics, electrics, and PLC interfaces
  • Ability to read and interpret tunnelling data, instrumentation, and geological reports
  • Must be safety-conscious and able to work in a team
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and rotational schedules
  • Valid certifications for confined space, working at heights, and first aid are a plus
  • Quantitative and qualitative risk assessment and monitoring of risk controls and actions involved in delivery and implementation of projects
  • Advanced skills in relevant computer software packages; Microsoft Suite; Primavera 6 etc

Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.


Compensation & Growth

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

  • If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Associate Events Social & Influencer Marketing
description: POSITION OVERVIEW: Society 18 is seeking a highly organized, creative, and proactive Associate of Events, Social & Influencer Marketing to support the agency's creator partnerships, experiential marketing initiatives, social media presence, and day-to-day operations. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves bringing ideas to life, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and is passionate about influencer marketing, social media, events, and creator culture. The Associate will work cross-functionally across events, social media, talent, partnerships, and operations while helping execute high-impact campaigns and experiences for creators and brand partners. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Social Media Marketing & Content Creation Manage day-to-day content planning for Society 18's Instagram and LinkedIn channels. Develop monthly content calendars aligned with agency campaigns, partnerships, creator announcements, and events. Write engaging social media copy, captions, and assist with music selection for short-form content. Design graphics in Canva, including creator announcements, milestone graphics, birthday posts, event promotions, partnership assets, and press announcements. Film and edit Instagram Reels, creator spotlights, event recap videos, and partnership content using CapCut. Maintain Instagram feed planning and overall visual consistency. Schedule and publish content across social media platforms. Publish Instagram Stories daily. Engage with creators, brand partners, and community members through comments and direct messages. Maintain creator posting trackers to ensure balanced representation across agency channels. Develop quarterly newsletters and email marketing campaigns in Flodesk. Create LinkedIn content highlighting agency partnerships, company milestones, leadership updates, and industry news. Build and maintain creator pages on the Society 18 website. Update creator biographies, follower counts, categories, and roster information as needed. Event Production & Experiential Marketing Assist with planning and executing creator dinners, networking mixers, brand activations, gifting experiences, industry events, and experiential campaigns from concept through post-event reporting. Develop and maintain event production documents, including run-of-show schedules, timelines, itineraries, outreach trackers, and production checklists. Research, source, and coordinate event venues, restaurants, and vendor partners. Build and maintain agency venues and preferred vendor databases. Coordinate pricing, proposals, availability, contracts, and logistics with vendors. Support sponsorship outreach and assist in preparing partnership proposals and presentations. Manage creator invitations, RSVPs, guest lists, and attendee communications using CreatorIQ, Partiful, Airtable, and Google Sheets. Coordinate gifting logistics, product shipments, and vendor deliveries for events. Prepare Independent Contractor Agreements (ICAs), NDAs, vendor agreements, and supporting documentation. Organize event assets, contracts, invoices, presentations, production documents, and creative files in Dropbox. Provide on-site event support, including setup, vendor management, guest check-in, production coordination, and event breakdown. Capture behind-the-scenes photo and video content for real-time social media coverage. Create post-event recap presentations in Canva and track creator coverage using Archive. Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships Pitch creators for brand activations, networking events, creator trips, fashion weeks, festivals, and industry experiences, including ESSENCE Festival, New York Fashion Week, Coachella, and other cultural moments. Support creator onboarding by updating internal databases, website profiles, onboarding materials, and social media assets. Assist with proactive creator pitching for paid brand partnerships. Support talent scouting initiatives and maintain the agency's talent scouting database. Research new creators, emerging trends, and partnership opportunities. Executive & Administrative Operations Coordinate meetings, calendars, and scheduling with creators, brands, vendors, and internal team members. Prepare meeting agendas, capture notes, and distribute follow-up action items. Maintain internal databases, presentations, production trackers, reporting dashboards, and operational documents. Research and source brand contacts across beauty, fashion, travel, hospitality, wellness, food & beverage, and lifestyle industries using Apollo, Airtable, LinkedIn, and additional research tools. Support day-to-day agency operations and assist with special projects as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 1â3 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, events, talent management, PR, or a related field. Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong creative eye for branding, design, and social content. Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: The ideal candidate is creative, resourceful, highly organized, and excited to help build meaningful experiences for creators and brand partners. They enjoy bringing ideas to life, solving problems, collaborating across teams, and staying on top of emerging social and cultural trends. They are equally comfortable planning an event, editing a Reel, coordinating logistics, mentoring interns, or supporting creator partnershipsâalways with a positive attitude and strong attention to detail.
